steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Thuy Giai, a water element crab, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: claws reaching toward the food; (3) EAT: snipping the food with its claws; (4) EAT: bringing a claw to its mouth, bubbles rising. Row 2: (5) EAT: blowing happy bubbles; (6) PLAY: scuttling sideways; (7) PLAY: a fast sideways dash; (8) PLAY: a small hop with claws up. Row 3: (9) PLAY: clacking claws in a dance; (10) PLAY: landing in a wide stance; (11) PLAY: claws up cheering, bubbles; (12) REFUSE food: hiding its face behind its claws. Row 4: (13) PETTED: eye stalks relaxed, blushing; (14) WAVE hello: waving one claw; (15) SAD: claws down, eyes drooping; (16) ANGRY: snapping its claws, steaming bubbles.
